subject: Audit transcript extract and selective redaction playbook for SIG/CAIQ submission
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novomed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: NovoMed Audit <audit@novomed.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity transcripts for SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last week. As part of our SIG/CAIQ submission and prep for a SOC2 readiness review, our auditors have asked for a reproducible package of Redwood admin activity covering the last 12 months (2026-04-01 -> 2027-03-31). Specifically they want: 

- A list of event types captured (console_login, api_key_create/revoke, model_deploy, route_update, permission_change, privileged_session_start/end, kms_key_unwrap).
- Per-event timestamps (ISO8601, with timezone) and an immutable sequence id to preserve ordering.
- Operator identity; we can accept pseudonymized operator IDs but need consistent mapping for the 12-month window.
- Field-level redaction guidance (we need to avoid session tokens, IPs only if requested).
- Export formats pref: Parquet (columnar) with Avro schema OR gzipped JSONL per-day shards.
- Chain-of-custody: signed manifest with SHA256 checksums and a deliverable method (SFTP push or presigned S3).

Can you confirm what Redwood logs today, retention defaults, and the export mechanisms you support? Also please call out any constraints for long-term retention or legal hold. If you have a sample manifest + schema that would help the auditors accept the format faster.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Compliance Manager, NovoMed
[attachment: novo_requirements_summary.pdf]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity transcripts for SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can produce a compliance-ready export that meets the auditors' checklist. High-level options and constraints below; see attached spec and sample manifest.

What we currently log (short list):
- console_login (success/failure) with auth_method and mfa flag
- api_key_create / api_key_revoke (metadata: key_id, creator_id, expiration)
- model_deploy / model_rollback (version, target_pool)
- route_update / route_delete (route_id, changed_by)
- permission_change (role, changed_by, before/after role mapping)
- privileged_session_start / privileged_session_end (session_id, duration, reason)
- kms_key_unwrap (key_id, requester_id)

Retention and default behavior:
- Admin activity default retention: 90 days for full-detail logs.
- Compliance retention options: we can extend to 1 year or multi-year on agreement (reservations apply for storage and export).
- Legal hold: we can flag an account and freeze deletion; flagged data will be retained at least until hold removal.

Export methods we support:
1) Parquet with Avro schema (recommended for SIG): per-day shards, gzip compressed, with an accompanying .avsc schema file.
2) JSONL (newline-delimited JSON), gzipped, partitioned by day.
3) Direct SFTP push or presigned S3 URLs. We can also push into your S3 bucket (cross-account) with an acceptance HMAC handshake.

Chain-of-custody and integrity:
- We produce a signed manifest (JSON) that includes file list, gzipped size, SHA256 checksums, sequence_id range, event count, and a server-side HMAC signature.
- We support an additional signature using a customer-supplied public key for manual verification.

Redaction/pseudonymization options (we can do any of the below):
- Pseudonymize operator_id deterministically (map kept for the requested window only).
- Remove/zero-out session_token and session_cookie fields.
- IP address: we can provide full IPs, /24 masked, or remove entirely depending on your policy.

Next steps - please confirm:
- Preferred format (Parquet+Avro OR JSONL gzipped)
- Desired retention period for this export (90 days default / 1 year / custom)
- Whether deterministic pseudonymization for operator_id is acceptable, or if you require the cleartext mapping under secure channel.

Attached: admin_activity_export_spec_v2.pdf and signed-manifest-sample-20270404.json (example). If you want, we can provision a 1-day test bundle to a presigned S3 link for ingest validation.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Compliance & Trust, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[attachment: admin_activity_export_spec_v2.pdf]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novomed.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity transcripts for SIG/CAIQ evidence

Elena — quick technical clarifications from infra so the bundle is ingestable into your tooling: 

1) Ordering and sequence IDs: we will include a monotonically increasing sequence_id per event and a per-file range in the manifest so you can reconstruct strict ordering across shard boundaries.

2) Event schema and nullable fields: parity with Avro schema (attached parquet-avro-schema-20270403.avsc). We will avoid nullable operator_id if pseudonymized; if you prefer redaction, operator_id will be the empty string.

3) Sampling and size: full export for 12 months will be large — estimate ~120M events for an active tenancy of your size. We can provide a deterministic 0.1% sample set for early validation plus a full export. Sampling preserves sequence_id gaps and includes a manifest that lists the included ranges.

4) Timezone normalization: all timestamps will be delivered in UTC with original offset preserved in a metadata field.

5) Access controls on delivery: SFTP credentials or cross-account S3 write-only role recommended. If you choose presigned S3, links will expire after 7 days; we can increase if necessary.

6) SLA for export production: standard turnaround for a one-time compliance package is 5 business days after acceptance of scope; expedited 48-hour option available with a priority fee.

If legal wants the clear mapping of pseudonymized operator IDs, we need a separate secure channel request (we can hand over under an executed NDA/SSAE trust agreement).

-Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novomed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: NovoMed Audit <audit@novomed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity transcripts for SIG/CAIQ evidence

Vivek / team — thanks for the clear options. NovoMed confirms the following: 

- Preferred export format: Parquet with Avro schema (we use columnar ingestion).
- Retention request for the delivered package: 1 year (2026-04-01 -> 2027-03-31).
- Pseudonymization: deterministic pseudonymization for operator_id is acceptable for auditors; we will request the mapping only if Legal issues a written specific data access request.
- IP handling: provide masked IPs (/24) rather than full addresses.
- Delivery method: cross-account S3 write-only role — please send IAM role ARN and brief onboarding steps.
- Please produce a 1-day test bundle (2027-03-31) to the same delivery location used in production as soon as possible so our ingestion team can validate schema and checksums.

We'll plan a 30-min sync after the test bundle to confirm. Can you share the acceptance checklist and estimated sizing so we can open a storage ticket?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Compliance Manager, NovoMed
[attachment: novomed_acceptance_checklist.xlsx]
